vision.name: Namekian Risk
vision.text:
ENDURANCE 2.
(If this card is discarded from your hand during combat, place it into play instead.)
POWER: Banish a Dragon Ball you own under your control to draw the bottom card of your Life Deck. If you banished a Namek Dragon Ball, You may shuffle your Life Deck and your attacks deal +1 stage of damage this combat. If you banished an Earth Dragon Ball, Rejuvenate 3.
